[[File:Bavo Six Crackens Field Guide.png|thumb|Representation of Bavo Six]]
'''Bavo Six''' was a notoriously powerful yet easy to produce [[Truth serum/Legends|truth serum]]. It was used by many organizations, from the [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Bavo Six would induce visual exaggeration and paranoia&mdash;shapes and outlines became distorted, and the victim became afraid of everything. The suspected chemical composition of Bavo Six was [[Regvis|R]]<sub>7</sub>[[Bospridium|Bo]]<sub>3</sub>Kr<sub>2</sub>, but that has yet to be confirmed.
